mapper.insert: INSERT INTO agents (id, name, type, status, current_task_id, started_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{name}, #{type}, #{status, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler}, #{currentTaskId}, #{startedAt}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, name, type, status, current_task_id, started_at, created_at, updated_at FROM agents ORDER BY created_at ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE agents SET status = #{status, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE agents SET current_task_id = #{taskId}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
